figurative_meaning_en: Mockingly, an unattractive person, especially in physical appearance
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই কুৎসিত যে মর্কটের মতো দেখতে।
তার চেহারা দেখে মনে হয় মর্কটের মতো।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so ugly that he looks like a monkey.
Her appearance reminds me of a little monkey.
note: Refers to the macaque monkey species, commonly used in colloquial Bengali for ridicule.
